### Flag details

#### `sticker`

- `--packname`, `-p` <value>: Sticker pack name (default: arsa)
- `--author`, `-a` <value>: Author name (default: generated by: violajs)
- `--fit`, `-f` <value>: How to fit to 512px: inside (keep ratio, default) or fill (stretch to 512x512)
- `--rotate`, `-r` <value>: Rotate clockwise, in multiples of 90 degrees (example: 90, 180, -90)
- `--flip`: Flip image top-bottom (vertical)
- `--flop`: Flip image left-right (horizontal)

### Flag details

#### `nekopoi`

- `--search`, `-s` <value>: Search hentai by query, e.g. .nekopoi -s enjo kouhai
- `--page`, `-p` <value>: Usage: .nekopoi -g milf -p 2
- `--id`, `-i` <value>: Get hentai by id, e.g. .nekopoi -i <id>
- `--post`: Usage: .nekopoi -i <id> --post

#### `pornhub`

- `--search`, `-s` <value>: Search keyword, e.g. --search cooking
- `--page`, `-p` <value>: Result page number, starting at 1 (default: 1)
- `--ordering` <value>: Sort order: featured | newest | mostviewed | rating (default: newest)
- `--period` <value>: Time window: weekly | monthly | alltime (default: alltime)
